description: We study the design and rigorous analysis of algorithms and data structures. Topics may include dynamic programming, Fibonacci heaps, graph algorithms, string algorithms, parallel algorithms, and concurrent data structures.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed YSC2229 at a grade of at least D )
